pages.text: By studying ancient techniques, you have crafted a horn that can produce the sound of thunder to attract powerful Storm Necromancers who wander among the peaks. With a goat horn and the power of the storm, you can devise a trap to ensnare their arrogant lives.

However, you realize that this replica horn still has room for improvement. If you could find a way to craft a horn from the broken crown of a Storm Necromancer you have defeated... perhaps someone might answer the challenge you send forth?
